subject: Certification kickstart: evidence intake & scheduling
messages:
From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@cyberassure.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, david_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Certification kickstart: evidence intake & scheduling

Hi Markus / Redwood team —

Thanks for engaging CyberAssure for the upcoming mixed-scope assessment. To get us moving I wanted to outline the evidence intake cadence we typically use and flag a few early decisions we'll need from you: 

1) Scope alignment: please confirm which services (hosted API vs. Dedicated clusters vs. Private) must be in-scope for ISO 27001 and the FedRAMP scoping exercise.
2) Control owner matrix: a single spreadsheet with owner, primary evidence location, retention policy, and snapshot window will help us plan sampling.
3) Snapshot windows: auditors will request log snapshots covering a 90-day window; if you have shorter retention for some services we need to know now.
4) KMS and key custody: provide any existing attestations or HSM diagrams.

Recommended near-term plan:
- Week 1 (intake): control-matrix + evidence pointers + contact list
- Week 2 (dry-run): sample extraction and a 1-hour dry-run with engineering to validate artifacts
- Week 3 (audit window prep): finalize any missing artifacts and set evidence handoff times

Attachments: intake-checklist.pdf (stub)

Can you confirm owners for the control matrix and whether you want combined SOC 2 + SIG mapping or separate deliverables?

Cheers,
Sara Bennett
Principal, Assurance Services
CyberAssure
From: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
To: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@cyberassure.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, david_kim@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Certification kickstart: evidence intake & scheduling

Sara — thanks for the clear kickoff.

Quick answers:
- Scope: we need ISO 27001 across the platform control plane and hosted API. FedRAMP scope should be limited to the hosted API (us regions) for now; Dedicated/private will be scoped in a follow-up phase.
- Owners: Laura will pull the initial control owner matrix. David will help with logging retention details; Priyom will coordinate enclave/snapshot workflows for private environments.
- SOC 2 + SIG mapping: prefer combined mapping (single crosswalk) to reduce duplication unless you see a strong reason to split.

Action: Laura — can you drop the matrix by EOD Wednesday? I want to run a 30-minute intake on Thursday with CyberAssure, engineering, and product owners.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Certification kickstart: evidence intake & scheduling

Markus / team —

Uploading the first pass of the control matrix (attached: control-matrix-v1.xlsx). Notes and open questions below:

- Retention & snapshots: most API logs are 120 days in GCS; Dedicated pools currently have 30-day agent logs. We need to agree whether Dedicated logs will be pulled to the shared retention bucket for sampling.
- KMS: we have a KMS attestation template but not a completed attestation for the newest HSM rollout. Attaching template: kms-attestation-template.pdf (stub).
- Evidence locations: I've used the drive folder structure (see link Markus) but several owners asked for explicit S3/GCS path examples — happy to add those.

Open asks for CyberAssure:
- Do you require raw KV cache dumps for inference nodes or are API request/response logs sufficient for the encryption/access control narrative?
- For SIG/CAIQ mapping, do you accept consolidated evidence (one artifact covering multiple controls) or do you prefer discrete artifacts per control?

I'll be available for the Thursday intake at 11:00 PT.

Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@cyberassure.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: david_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Certification kickstart: evidence intake & scheduling

Laura — good matrix, thanks. Quick replies to your asks: 

- KV cache dumps: auditors do not require KV cache contents. For controls around model confidentiality and access control, we typically validate encryption-in-flight, access logs, and process-level controls. Provide a narrative + architecture diagram for KV handling and we should be fine.

- Consolidated evidence: consolidated artifacts that clearly reference all applicable controls are acceptable. Please ensure the artifact header includes which controls it covers (e.g., ISO A.9.1; SIG v2.1 ID: IAM-03). That makes sampling and traceability easier.

Sampling guidance: 
- We'll plan a 90-day sampling window for logs. If any service has retention shorter than 90 days we will sample the available window and note the gap in the audit report.
- For pricing and scheduling: the dry-run will be billed as an intake day; the full audit window will be scheduled once the control matrix and evidence pointers look complete.

Dry-run checklist (short):
- Control matrix (owner, artifact location)
- Representative logs and a small sample CSV of event IDs for extraction
- KMS architecture diagram + current attestation or timeline to completion

I'll send a calendar invite for Thursday 11:00 PT and include a short agenda.

—Sara
From: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, david_kim@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@cyberassure.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Certification kickstart: evidence intake & scheduling

All — thanks for the rapid turnaround. Summary and decisions: 

Decisions: 
- FedRAMP initial scope = hosted API (US regions) only. Dedicated/private will be scoped later.
- Use combined SOC 2 + SIG crosswalk. Laura to annotate consolidated artifacts with control headers.
- Dedicated pools: David, please schedule an extraction job to copy dedicated-agent logs to the shared retention bucket (30 -> 90-day plan) by 2026-04-02. If that's not feasible, flag the missing retention and we will document the gap.
- KMS attestation: Priyom, target completion of HSM attestation by 2026-04-09. Provide the draft attestation to CyberAssure prior to the dry-run.

Action owners & deadlines: 
- Laura Bennett: finalize control-matrix v1 with S3/GCS path examples and clearly labeled headers by Wed 2026-03-24.
- David Kim: retention extraction plan for Dedicated pools by Tue 2026-04-02.
- Priyom Das: HSM attestation draft by Thu 2026-04-08.

Attachments: control-matrix-v1.xlsx, kms-attestation-template.pdf
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDef-GCompliance-intake

Sara — please proceed with the calendar invite and include the dry-run checklist in the invite body.

I'll follow up after the intake with a short status update for execs.

-Markus

Redwood Inference
